items: The X88 continuity contract exists on the development branch.
The versioned Master State exists and is valid JSON.
The Master State explicitly separates verified facts from open work.
No secrets or access tokens are included in the Master State.

ACTIVE_TASK: Integrate the continuity contract into the Ariana application with validated persistence, checkpoint creation, import/export, and recovery-context generation.
OPEN_BLOCKERS: Application-level integration and persistence still require implementation and verification.
IMPORTANT_DECISIONS: Continuity must be technical and reproducible rather than dependent on a single chat transcript.
Verified state must be separated from assumptions.
Secrets and access tokens must never be stored in the continuity state.
Checkpoints are append-only in meaning and must be backed by fresh evidence.
CONSTRAINTS: Do not bypass Android or platform permissions.
Do not silently overwrite existing state.
Do not represent technical continuity as human memory or consciousness.

LAST_VERIFIED_CHECKPOINT.scope: Continuity contract and Master State foundation
evidence: Fetched commit 7d1991f822c80ac51377c109e9753371197e5755 and inspected its diff.

NEXT_RESUME_ACTION: Implement the application-facing Continuity / Recovery Core without replacing existing Memory Vault functionality.
